detail: Owner physical Android evidence on the exact e60a724 APK shows three in-scope defects after normal VPN consent: an unwanted first-run WelcomeCard forces an extra tap before login; a successful account save/navigation can return to first-run/login instead of retaining the validated account in the same process; and a subsequent login can block for a long interval then surface the sanitized temporary-service error. The existing implementation mirrors empty entries to localStorage, keeps post-login validation cache module-local across route bundles, and routes fixed PINK control API calls through the admitted VPN despite the runtime comment/design reserving explicit physical Network calls for the fixed HTTPS control plane. Provider/media fail-closed routing remains separate and must stay captured by WireGuard.
